_source.what: Oracle answers for the equi-join workload at SF0.1. The queries are IN-HOUSE synthetic join-stress shapes (no upstream query of this form exists), so every value is the answer this build returns over the pinned graph-benchmark-ldbc SF0.1 store — verified by execution 2026-11-13 (release build, reused store copy; see the workload README). Rows compare with the graph-benchmark-ldbc lane's no-coercion rules (answers::compare).
_source.data: the pinned graph-benchmark-ldbc store at SF0.1 (graph-benchmark-ldbc CsvBasic-StringDateFormatter, CC BY 4.0 — the same data the graph-benchmark-ldbc, pathdb, snb-bi and agg-stress lanes run; workloads/graph-benchmark-ldbc/data.sha256)
_source.why: an engine-self oracle, recorded so the ratchet catches answer regressions in the join itself (a rewrite that drops or double-counts the product's surviving pairs fails the run); it is NOT an upstream answer and never gates on upstream behaviour
_source.regenerate: re-freezing the graph-benchmark-ldbc data set regenerates this file: run the lane, review each answer, re-record (the product and output sizes in the README's table move with the data). Per scale factor: a store at another SF resolves its own oracle-sf<SF>.json and fails loudly until one exists.
_source.verified: 2026-11-13, by execution over the graph-benchmark-ldbc SF0.1 store: e01 2184 birthday-equal Person pairs; e02 723576 browser-equal Person pairs; e03 3537568 (Comment, Person) pairs with comment length over 100 and equal browsers
